description_en: In the medieval settlement of Theco, there are two large courtyards that serve as religious and cultural centers. The courtyard located in the lower part is called Kvaylāchi, and the courtyard in the upper part is called Cvayalāchi. In Kvaylāchi, there is a worshipped temple of Brahmayāṇī Devī, and in Cvaylāchi, there is the Bālakumārī temple. These courtyards, developed as central hubs of the settlement, contain various heritage structures such as phalcās, sataḥ, caityas, and statues.There are very fewphalcāswith a single bay (kavala) in Nepālamaṇḍala, and the one in Kvaylāchi is among the few in the region to feature this design. Before the earthquake of VS 2072, thephalcāwas in very poor condition. After the earthquake, the upper part of thephalcāwas damaged and it remained in disrepair for nearly seven years. In 2024 CE (VS 2081), Godavarī Municipality reconstructed thephalcāin its original form.There is an inscription regarding its original construction, stating that Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa, a person living near thephalcāin Capāḥkva ṭola, built it in 1857 CE (NS 977). He hoped that the merit from constructing thisphalcāwould allow his deceased ancestors and future generations to reach heaven after death.Until the mid-2040s (VS), the descendants of the creator used to distributeSamaybajiduring Indrajātrā at thephalcā. However, after the land allocated to thephalcāwas lost, the tradition of distributingSamaybajiended, according to the family members of the concerned lineage (one of the clan members, Maharjana, male, age 83).
description_ne: एकै कवलमा स्वतन्त्र उभिएको यस्ता फल्चा नेपालमण्डलमा निकै कम संख्यामा छन् ।थेच्वको मध्यकाली बस्तीभित्र धार्मिक एवं सांस्कृतिक केन्द्रका रूपमा रहेका दुई ठुला चोक छन् । ती दुईमध्ये तल्लो भेगको चोकलाई क्वय्‌लाछि र माथिल्लोलाई च्वय्‌लाछि भनिन्छ । क्वय्‌लाछिमा थेच्वकी आरध्य देवी ब्रह्मायणीदेवीको भव्य मन्दिर छ भने च्वय्‌लाछिमा बालकुमारीको मन्दिर छ । बस्तीकै केन्द्रस्थलका रूपमा विकसित यी चोकमा फल्चा, सतः, चैत्य आदि अनेक मूर्त सम्पदा छन् । यो फल्चा क्वय्‌लाछि परिसरभित्र पर्ने सम्पदा हो । एकै कवलको फल्चा नेपालमण्डलमा निकै कम संख्यामा छन जसमध्ये यो फल्चा पनि पर्दछ । एकै कवलमा स्वतन्त्र उभिएको फल्चा विसं २०७२ को भूकम्प पूर्व नै जीर्ण अवस्थामा थियो । भूकम्प पश्चात माथिल्लो भाग भत्की बसेको फल्चा करिब ७ बर्ष दूरावस्थामै रह्यो । विसं २०८१ (सन् २०२४) मा गोदावरी नगरपालिकाले फल्चालाई पुरानै मौलिक स्वरूपमा पुनर्निर्माण गरेको हो ।यहाँ यसको प्रारम्भिक निर्माणसंग सम्बन्धित अभिलेख प्राप्त छ । अभिलेख अनुसार नेसं ९७७ (सन् १८५७) मा यसै फल्चा छेवैमा घर भएका अर्थात् चपाःक्व टोलका लक्ष्मीनारायण भावले आफ्ना दीवंगत पितृ र बाँचेका पुस्ताले मृत्यु पश्चात् स्वर्गलोक पाओस भन्ने कामनाले फल्चा बनाएको उल्लेखित छ ।फल्चामा विसं २०४० को दशकको मध्यसम्म पनि निर्माताका दरसन्तानले इन्द्रजात्रामा समय्‌बजि बाँढ्ने गरेका थिए । फल्चालाई छुट्याइएको जग्गा फल्चाको स्वामित्वबाट गुमे पश्चात् समय्‌बजि बाँढ्ने परम्परा बन्द भएको सम्बन्धित परिवारका सदस्य बताउछन् (one of the clan members, Maharjana, male, age 83) ।

historical_events.event_description: An inscription details thephalcā's original construction. It states that Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa, a resident of Capāḥkva ṭola near thephalcā, built it with the belief that the merit from constructing thisphalcāwould ensure his deceased ancestors and future generations would attain heaven after death.

Prior to the earthquake of VS 2072, thephalcāwas in a dilapidated state. The earthquake caused significant damage to the upper portion of the structure, and it remained in disrepair for nearly seven years. In 2024 CE (VS 2081), Godavarī Municipality undertook the reconstruction of thephalcā, restoring it to its original form.
